headline: Air pollution is costing Pakistan an estimated 6.5% of GDP and, according to the State of Global Air cited by the OICCI, causes more than 248,000 premature deaths a year, the Express Tribune reports.

card.desc: 92% aabadi WHO ki interim hadd se zyada PM2.5 mein

caption:
Fazai aloodgi Pakistan ko GDP ka 6.5% nuksaan de rahi hai!
Express Tribune ke mutabiq OICCI ne State of Global Air ke hawale se bataya ke fazai aloodgi se har saal 248,000 se zyada log qabl-az-waqt mar jate hain. 92% aabadi WHO ki interim hadd se zyada PM2.5 wale ilaqon mein rehti hai.
Aap ke shehar mein smog ka kya haal hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
